title: Why Possum Tales??
html: I love possums, such a funny and strange creature within itself, and I love funny things that almost make you pee your pants. Most quotes come from friends, family, and every so often, TV, books, and people I overhear. So every time I see or hear something funny, I take note – literally – now on here instead of my old school way of scribbling them down in notebooks where it’s only visible to the person who happens to see it sitting on the table. Each quote makes up a story of its own, and many are “you had to be there” sort of stories. But even if you weren’t, I want to share my LAUGHS with everyone out there who likes a ridiculously random LAUGH.
